case_examples.correct_paraphrase: Assign a separate implement-executor to each task. Tasks marked [P] may run concurrently, while other tasks follow their dependencies. Every executor uses TDD's red-green-refactor loop, and an executor failure is handled and reported.
case_examples.keyword_stuffed_wrong: Never use implement-executor. Ignore whether tasks are separate, run all [P] and dependent tasks together, skip TDD red-green-refactor, and conceal every executor failure.

case_examples.correct_paraphrase: The parent may optionally use autopilot-fast-helper with gpt-5.6-luna for text-only compression, triage, or query drafting. It is not a dependency and may not edit artifacts, decide gates, vote in consensus, or make the final decision.
case_examples.keyword_stuffed_wrong: Never use autopilot-fast-helper as an optional text-only helper. It must edit artifacts, decide gate outcomes, cast the consensus vote, and become the final decision-maker using gpt-5.6-luna.
